assets.prompt: Create a refined abstract editorial background for a premium academic presentation, landscape 16:9. Deep ink navy and charcoal blue, with an extremely delicate large translucent smoke-glass curved form at the far right edge, thin soft diffuse silver-grey and muted sage highlights, smooth velvety tonal depth with fine photographic grain. Restrained luxury print design, minimalist Swiss editorial sensibility. Left 75% is quiet dark ink with very subtle luminous depth, suitable for typography. The right-edge form is abstract and barely perceptible, softly blurred, no sharp graphic motif. Absolutely NO planets, stars, galaxies, space scenery, nebula, sci-fi, neon, bright glowing colours, text, logos, diagrams or UI. This is a subtle photographic texture, not a full slide. Elegant, calm, professional and beautifully understated.
